correctness.rationale: Each mutual-edge indicator has mean 1/d², overlapping edge-events are incompatible, and disjoint event families factor; hence E z^X=sum_r M_r((z-1)/d²)^r. The line graph has m=nd/2 vertices, h=m(d-1) edges and n*C(d,3)+t triangles. Inclusion-exclusion gives M1,M2,M3; conversion of the factorial moments produces mu=n/(2d), variance=n(d-1)²/(2d³), kappa3=n(d-1)²(d-2)²/(2d^5)-6t/d^6. Independently substituted the M1/2/3 formulas into SymPy and factored every difference with claimed moments to identically zero; boundary d=1,2,3 and t≤n*C(d,2)/3 establish the sign conditions. The variance/mean ratio ((d-1)/d)² uniquely determines positive integer d, then mu yields n and kappa3 yields t. Exhaustive 16-graph verifier source read, not substituted for universal algebra.

value.rationale: The first three observable cumulants of a simple natural local-interaction experiment recover three intrinsic graph parameters, with a complete sharp sign stratification. This is useful as an exact model-identifiability/motif statistic; the matching-polynomial reduction is classical but the inverse and signs for this model are independently motivated.

final_claim: For all finite positive-degree simple d-regular graphs, the first three population cumulants of the number of mutually selected edges under independent uniform one-neighbor choice determine n, d and the graph triangle count exactly; the third cumulant has the asserted sharp degree-specific sign classification.
limitations: Assumes exact population cumulants, independent uniform neighbor selections and positive regular degree; no sampling error or general irregular graph reconstruction.
